notes: CRM notes: mid-market product analytics vendor exploring moving from Hosted -> Dedicated for production traffic. Team = Head of Platform (J. Park), Lead PM (M. Chen), infra lead (R. Osei). Primary motivator: unpredictable token costs on hosted during end-of-month processing spikes; want predictable unit economics + data isolation. Hosted API used in pilot (search + rerank flows) — good quality, latency meets product needs, but ops want reserved capacity. Key ask: pricing that supports a phased commit (ramp) rather than big up-front commit. Quote from PM: "We need a predictable tailwind for budget forecasting — flexible ramping and clear overage rules." Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs exported to their SIEM, customer-managed KMS, retention 365 days, data residency US only. POC scope: 8 weeks on Dedicated with 2-node baseline (A100 equivalent), load test to 2x current qps, validate autoscale and burst. Pricing negotiation details discussed: proposer options: (A) 6-month ramp: 25% commit months 1-2, 50% months 3-4, 100% months 5-6; (B) 12-month flat commit at 60% with higher discount; burst allowance: up to 2x baseline at discounted overage rate; overage caps (monthly) to prevent runaway charges; early-exit ramp schedule with 60-day notice and tapering credits. Customer asked for an interim discount for POC usage and a cap on overage dollars during first 90 days. SE asked for telemetry access and a small agent token to test KV/prefix caching behavior. Action items: send detailed Dedicated pricing matrix, include burst engineering notes, draft SOW with ramp schedule and POC terms, legal to review data processing addendum. Linked artifacts: pricing deck (drive), hosted pilot logs (s3), fireflies transcript of Feb 18 demo. Tone: pragmatic, engineering-first, cost-sensitive but willing to commit with clear ramp/exit clauses.
